name: magies-pdf
description: Magies Office is a local-first desktop workspace for Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF documents.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:node && vite build
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:node && c8 --all --include="src/core/**/*.ts" --include="electron/**/*.cjs" --exclude="**/*.test.*" --reporter=text --reporter=html --check-coverage --lines=80 --statements=80 --functions=80 --branches=75 npm test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.pack:dir: npm run prepare:office-runtime && npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package
scripts.pack:mac: npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64
scripts.pack:mac-x64: npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --x64 --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64
scripts.pack:mac-arm64: npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && npm run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --arm64 --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64
scripts.pack:win: npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=arm64 && npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=x64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish=never && cross-env npm_config_arch=arm64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --arm64 --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=win32 --arch=arm64
scripts.pack:win-x64: npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=x64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --x64 --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.pack:win-arm64: npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=arm64 && npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=arm64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --arm64 --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=win32 --arch=arm64
scripts.pack:linux: npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=linux --arch=x64 && npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=x64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --x64 --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=linux --arch=x64
scripts.pack:linux-x64: npm run prepare:office-runtime -- --platform=linux --arch=x64 && npm run build && cross-env npm_config_arch=x64 NODE_OPTIONS=--disable-warning=DEP0190 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --x64 --publish=never && npm run verify:office-package -- --platform=linux --arch=x64
